metric_definitions.wall_seconds: Solver CLI only, excluding copying and grading.
metric_definitions.success: Original graders: Vitest target spec exit 0; code45 set-F1 >= 0.9; blind Claude Haiku 4.5 explanation score >= 0.6. Wall timeouts remain failures.
metric_definitions.cost_usd: Base Standard list-price estimate, not a subscription charge; long-context surcharge not identifiable from cumulative usage.
metric_definitions.num_turns: Native exec user turn is not a model/API turn; recorded as null. Exact model requested with -m; backend resolved id not independently exposed.
